## Safe by default
Imported as-is this workflow makes **zero network calls** and writes nothing to HubSpot.

- `SANDBOX_MODE=true` → mock fixture only
- `DRY_RUN=true` → no writes
- `RENEWAL_DEALS_CREATION_ENABLED=false`
- `RENEWAL_STAGE_UPDATES_ENABLED=false`
- `MILESTONE_WRITEBACK_ENABLED=false`
- `SEND_SLACK_ALERTS=false`

Live writes also need a token, an explicit renewal pipeline + stage mapping, and an untripped circuit breaker.

## Live HubSpot reads
Deals search (paginated) → existing renewals search → v4 deal→company associations → companies batch read → active owners.

All read-only; any search failure halts the run.

## Radar & provisioning
Milestones: exact 90/60/30 days (catch-up only with write-back).
Provisioning: any enterprise contract ≤90d with no renewal deal.
Duplicate guards: source ID → idempotency key → company association → in-run.

## HubSpot writes
`Split HubSpot Operations` re-checks every flag and throws if any disagree. Creates run first, one batch per second, **no automatic retry** (a retried create could duplicate).
